posts.hook: Meta answered its AI trust problem with a hardware blitz
posts.caption: meta answered its ai trust problem with a hardware blitz at connect 2026 (vr glasses, camera-free ray-bans, a muse gadget on a lanyard), the fbi opened an investigation into whether hackers really breached its employee data, and claude helped uncover a novel crispr-like enzyme system, today's top hacker news story. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
